body.condition: Over the gamma-separated laws \(P\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm S}\) for which the common deterministic heavy- and Gaussian-arm schedules apply at sample size \(n\), the moving scalar row laws satisfy \[\lim_{\eta\downarrow0}\limsup_{n\to\infty}\sup_P\max_{\tau\in\mathcal T}\sup_{x\in\mathbb R}P_P\{|Z_{P,n}(\tau)-x|\le\eta\}=0.\]
